jen.p: Heads-up: OrionPay POC. Checklist: IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM delta sync, Okta group->RBAC mapping, tenant-level domain proofing (multi-brand), and EU residency. Need quick presales runbook + ballpark pricing. Who can pick this up?

omar.m: I got runbook. quick Q: expected concurrent SCIM patch rate? that changes hosted vs dedicated recommendation.

hana.t: Sales note: ~8k users, spikes during payroll windows (~6k ops in 1h), daily full sync at 03:00 UTC, deltas realtime. They want delegated tenant admins and custom role names.

jen.p: Good. Can Redwood include group claims in SAML assertions and honor custom role claim name?

omar.m: Yes — we can map attributes into assertions. example snippet I'll add to runbook. Watch assertion size for many groups. Recommend flattening nested groups on IdP.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Draft hosted + quota bump quote uploaded: https://redwood.s3/prequotes/orionpay-hosted.pdf

hana.t: Ballpark (estimate): Hosted standard = $1k/mo; Hosted + scim bump = $2.8k/mo; Dedicated onboarding = $18k one-time; Dedicated reserved = $6.5k/mo. EU region premium applies.

omar.m: Domain proofing: GA supports exact domain verification per tenant. wildcard/delegated proofing not GA — offer as eng engagement (4 weeks).

jen.p: Plan: Omar to produce runbook (SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta replay example, nested-group guidance), Hana to create provisional pricing and upload security questionnaire answers, I'll schedule tech call for Fri 11:00 CET and add sec/ops.

hana.t: I'll upload the draft quote and sec answers shortly.

omar.m: Sample SCIM PATCH I'll include in runbook: `curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/abc123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails","value":[{"value":"payroll@orion.example"}]}]}'`

jen.p: Thanks team, keeping momentum :thumbsup:
